theme_and_archetype.vibe: Authority, Clarity, Professional, Reliable, and Premium

rules: No jump greater than 2 tailwind steps between headings and subheadings.
Always use tight tracking on large headers to create a premium feel.
Overlines and labels must be uppercase with wide tracking.
Must ensure robust latin-ext character support for Czech diacritics (ř, č, š, ž, etc.).
Tinted neutrals only. Avoid pure #000 or #FFF where possible.
Ensure text meets APCA high-contrast standards.
Primary Orange is strictly reserved for primary CTAs, active states, and map markers. Do not overuse.

grid_modes.marketing: Tetris Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, wide gap-8 to gap-12). Focus on asymmetric overlaps.
grid_modes.dashboard: Control Room Grid (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4, tight gap-4 or gap-6). High density, utilize full height for children.

rules: Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
Never center everything. Left-align dense content and paragraphs.
Use optical alignment for icons + text in buttons.

component_strategy.global: Shadcn UI base heavily customized. Use sharp or lightly rounded edges (max rounded-md or rounded-lg). Avoid deep soft shadows; prefer 1px solid borders.
component_strategy.buttons: Flat colors, no gradients. Primary: bg-orange-500 text-white hover:bg-orange-600. Define explicit focus states.
component_strategy.cards: Dashboard cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
component_strategy.maps: Leaflet map tiles MUST be styled contextually. Use CartoDB Positron for light mode, Dark Matter for dark mode. Use custom SVG pins colored in Primary Orange.
component_strategy.forms: Strictly use Shadcn Forms. No native inputs. Use step-by-step wizard style for Demand Creation.
component_strategy.tables: Dense padding for Admin/Invoice tables. Right-align numerical data (CZK prices).

visual_enhancers.sticky_headers: Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 or bg-zinc-950/60 with a 1px bottom border. Saturated backdrop.
visual_enhancers.dash_widgets: Use 'Grid Borders' for technical data sections (border-r border-b border-border/40).
visual_enhancers.marketing_hero: Hero Image Overlay must not exceed bg-zinc-950/50. If image isn't visible, use a gradient overlay instead.
visual_enhancers.icons: Phosphor Icons. 'Regular' weight for dense UI/dashboards, 'Duotone' weight for marketing sections.

motion_interaction.hover_states: ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover. E.g. hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-900.
motion_interaction.transitions: Use specific properties: transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease. No 'transition-all'.
motion_interaction.entry_animations: Use Framer Motion for staggered fade-up lists (Demand feeds, steps).
motion_interaction.loading: Replace default spinners with a subtle orange tracing beam or progress bar across the top.

domain_specific_rules.marketplace_trust: Use verified badges and user ratings prominently. Implement high-contrast pricing tiers highlighting the 'Most Popular' subscription.
domain_specific_rules.service_area: Display map service area with a semi-transparent orange circle overlay.
domain_specific_rules.weather_nameday: Integrate Weather and Nameday subtly into the Dashboard Header using small, clean typography (labels). It should provide utility without stealing focus from the main demand feed.

media_assets.description: High-end, modern architectural interior under renovation. Use for Landing Page Hero section.
Professional craftsman with power tool. Use for 'How it works' or Supplier feature cards.
Carpenter working at workbench. Use for Testimonials or Service Categories.
Exposed framing interior. Use for Customer Dashboard placeholder states or Demand creation background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and setup 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' fonts supporting latin-ext. Remove standard Inter/Roboto imports.
Refactor dashboard views (Supplier, Customer, Admin) to use the 'Control Room' grid layout.
Integrate Shadcn UI across all forms, tables, and dialogs. Set the CSS radius to 0.5rem (8px).
Update tailwind.config.js with the specified color_palette, enforcing the high-contrast light and dark themes.
Style the Leaflet map component (DraggableMap.jsx / LiveMap.jsx) to load CartoDB base maps dynamically based on the current theme.
Implement Framer Motion for the Demand Feed cards and Landing page 'How it works' steps.
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, demand cards) have a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case.
